verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit mechanisms for deletion (send a 'Delete Person' track event) and suppression, plus support for synthetic emails to meet PII/data-residency requirements, giving AI-native users API-driven control over profile deletion. However there is no documentation of configurable data retention periods/policies or automated retention scheduling. missing for 10: explicit retention-period settings/policy docs, bulk/workspace-level deletion controls, independent confirmation that deletion via API is honored end-to-end.
